fact: Decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025 requires non-resident remote service suppliers to register on an electronic platform set up by the tax administration, which then issues them a tax identification number electronically; it enters into force six months after publication.
system: DGI electronic platform for non-resident suppliers

fact: The Direction generale des impots launched in May 2026 the electronic platform 'Taxation on Digital Services' for non-resident foreign providers to register, declare their Moroccan turnover and pay VAT, under decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025.
